arStrings.szText:
{c_important}{u}Crackling Energy{/u}{/c} now gains {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"*100|%x|]{/c} damage for every level in Shock Skills you have equipped and enemies hit have a {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"*100|%|]{/c} chance to refund a charge. Upon reaching maximum {c_important}{u}Crackling Energy{/u}{/c}, you rapidly unleash all charges on the closest enemy to you dealing {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100|%x|]{/c} increased damage. 
You cannot gain charges from hits while rapidly discharging.
